name: Flux CD GitOps Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source GitOps continuous delivery controllers and CLI for Kubernetes; reconcile Git/OCI/Helm sources, deploy Kustomize and Helm resources, and automate image updates without a vendor-imposed software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires a user-managed Kubernetes cluster, registry/source repositories, and operations; cluster compute, storage, network, registry, and external integrations may cost money. Flux v1 is end-of-life; this listing covers actively maintained Flux v2 only.
